target: macOS Tahoe 26 Control Center and hardware-level feedback

observed_runtime.version: Local macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, identified in Software Update by the parent agent
observed_runtime.method: Read-only native CUA inspection. Control Center became accessible after Menu Bar Settings > Add Controls, then Done. No radio, pairing, network or power setting was changed.

control_center.container: Separate floating glass capsules and circles; no enclosing rectangle, headline, Back or Close button.
rows: Wi-Fi 138x62 left; Now Playing 138x138 right spanning two rows
AirDrop 138x62 left; Stage Manager and Screen Mirroring 62x62 circles right
Dark Mode and Capture Screen 62x62 circles left; Focus 138x62 right
Display 290x62, thin horizontal level control and endpoint glyphs
Sound 290x62, thin horizontal level control and endpoint glyphs
control_center.uncertainty: Dimensions were observed from runtime screenshots, not extracted layout constraints. Native capture background/alpha was unsuitable for exact material-color measurement. No private network or device names are recorded.

hierarchy: Known Networks with approximately 32px rows, active circular glyph and security indicator

observed_runtime.bluetooth: The native Bluetooth accessibility tree became unavailable. Its pixel layout was not observed; the new layout follows the dedicated title/switch/device-row/footer pattern and exposes actual Linux state.
observed_runtime.battery: No local native battery popover was observed. Content hierarchy uses Apple's Tahoe battery-status documentation and the Linux backend's available telemetry.

user_screenshot_evidence.observed: Hardware-level OSD at x1602,y41 on a 1920px-wide screen, approximately 290x62, capsule shape, actual output title or Display, thin track and endpoint glyphs. User states that an open Control Center updates its existing control instead of showing a separate OSD.
user_screenshot_evidence.privacy: Original screenshots were viewed locally only. They contain private desktop content and are not copied into the repository or generated fixtures.

primary_sources.supports: Tahoe battery percentage, power source, energy mode, charging information and significant-energy app categories
Icon toggles, detail disclosure, sliders, control rearrangement and resize behavior; this successfully retrieved revision is macOS 27, so Tahoe geometry comes from local runtime instead
Tahoe customizable Control Center and Liquid Glass design

implemented: Default 4-column floating grid matching the observed arrangement, independent glass surfaces and thin sliders
Existing custom layout persistence, resize, reorder and gallery retained
Dedicated Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and battery popovers with Settings footer and no generic Back/Close/pinning controls
Separate radio-icon click and detail-label click; native radio/profile writes retain confirmed state until backend readback
Actual battery percentage and level, charging/source and available Linux power-profile choices
Actual compositor hardware-event values update visible Control Center controls; closed controls route to one top-right OSD
Native display brightness remains read-only until an actual setter exists; hardware events display observed brightness without writing local dimming preferences
Passive native OSD ApplicationWindow with compositor role 3, no focus/input and no reserved area; common state/content shared with the explicit Popup.Item preview

verification.test_control_center: 14 isolated persistence and real-pointer gesture cases passed
verification.verify_control_linux: Confirmed readback, coalesced volume requests, rejected writes and disconnection behavior passed
verification.verify_control_tahoe: Actual QML grid geometry, radio/profile pointer requests, readback-only state, unavailable hardware, battery percentage, Main.qml hardware signal routing and OSD dismissal passed using synthetic backend data; injected native-host routing also verifies that the preview popup remains closed
verification.captures: Synthetic fixture captures only; software Qt with Reduce Transparency enabled validates geometry/text, not shader material or native symbol rendering
verification.hardware: No host hardware settings changed. Native compositor event patch and real Linux rendering require CI/disposable VM validation.
verification.native_osd: The actual Wayland role/focus-retention behavior remains a Linux compositor CI gate; the local fixture validates routing and state only.

remaining_parity: Wi-Fi scan, join/authentication, Personal Hotspot and security indicators are not provided by the current backend; no fabricated networks or locks
Bluetooth pairing/connect/disconnect and per-device class artwork are not connected
Battery charge-time estimates, significant-energy apps, battery health and Apple-specific energy behavior are unavailable
Balanced maps to Automatic as a Linux power-profile label; this does not implement Apple's adaptive power policy
Capture Screen and Stage Manager have explicit unavailable details; the Capture Screen glyph is currently generic camera artwork
Native brightness pointer adjustment remains unavailable; only real hardware-service reports are displayed
Battery outline and level fill are an independent drawing; exact native glyph parity is unverified
Glass tint/refraction, native glyph rendering under GPU, popup morphs and dismissal timings have not been matched frame by frame
Existing customized users retain their chosen control layout; the new default applies to new layouts or Reset Control Center
